- $v=|p+\omega q+\omega^2 t|^2 = p^2+q^2+t^2 - (pq+qt+tp)$. With $e_1=3$ and $e_2=-4$, $p^2+q^2+t^2 = 9+8=17$, so $v = 17+4 = 21$.
- $u = 2p-q-t = 3p-3$, using $q+t = 3-p$. Writing $w=p-1$, so $u=3w$.

Substituting $x=w+1$ into $f$ gives $f(w+1)=w^3-7w-2$, so $w^3 = 7w+2$. Then
$$u^3 = 27w^3 = 189w+54 = 63u+54.$$
Therefore $u^3 - 3uv = u^3 - 63u = 54$, so $2\operatorname{Re}(s_1^3)=54$ and $\operatorname{Re}(s_1^3)=27$.
